title: HappySMP
description: Friendly survival SMP with 10 free ranks!
body:
🌟 Welcome to HappySMP! 🌟

HappySMP is a brand-new friendly Survival Multiplayer (SMP) server built for players who just want to relax, explore, and have fun in a positive community. Whether you’re a casual builder, a dedicated explorer, or someone who just wants to hang out with friends, HappySMP is the perfect place for you!

We believe Minecraft should be stress-free, so we’ve added unique features that make your experience even better. No need to worry about griefers, random PvP, or spending money to unlock cool perks—you can earn everything just by playing!

✨ Why Join HappySMP?

A grief-free survival world with land claiming to keep your builds safe.

Free cosmetics & collectables to customize your experience.

Earnable ranks that reward you just for playing!

Toggle PvP on or off anytime no more surprise battles.

A friendly and welcoming community for players of all skill levels.

If you’re looking for a fun, safe, and exciting SMP to call home, then join HappySMP today and start your adventure with us! 💚
